# TPC-DS-OBT Q87

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds_obt
```

> [TPC-DS-OBT](../../tpc-ds-obt.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS-OBT queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  COUNT(*)
FROM (
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
      obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
      obt.sold_date_d_date
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      (
        obt.sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
        AND obt.ship_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11
      )
      AND channel = 'store'
  )
  EXCEPT
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
      obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
      obt.sold_date_d_date
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      (
        obt.sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
        AND obt.bill_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11
      )
      AND channel = 'catalog'
  )
  EXCEPT
  (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      obt.bill_customer_c_last_name,
      obt.bill_customer_c_first_name,
      obt.sold_date_d_date
    FROM tpcds_sales_returns_obt AS obt
    WHERE
      (
        obt.sold_date_sk = sold_date_d_date_sk
        AND obt.bill_customer_sk = bill_customer_c_customer_sk
        AND obt.sold_date_d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11
      )
      AND channel = 'web'
  )
) AS cool_cust
```
